evidence_limits: Single exploratory training success with intermediate native practice feedback and cross-demo study. Not repeatability, held-out generalization, causal proof of roll correction, or teleop wall-time parity.

successful_mount_sequence.description: At safe distance rotate held detector about mounting normal, matching demo grating orientation in head frame
Cancel to measured q and approach base .10m, then shallow arm advance
Cancel to measured q, base advance .015m; attachment still false
Explicit grip1 with measured-q hold; returned after2ticks, attachment still false
Measured-q hold and base retreat .20m; finish success true

warning: Coordinates are observed TRAIN20 practice configuration, not unseen-world commands. Re-ground objects, wall normal and nail using public RGBD. Existing grasp offsets differ from human; hand orientation alone is insufficient.
